source: the authors' dedicated Monte Carlo measurement of the optimized L = 4 state, sent by Rong Cheng on 2026-09-19 for the QMBL entry (private correspondence, via Tao Li); outputs as received in sources/2509.13746-authors-pyro-result.dat, -pyro-blocking.dat, -pyro-chains.dat, README in sources/2509.13746-authors-README_QMBL.txt
note: H = J sum S_i.S_j, J = 1, 256 sites, periodic. One standard error of the energy from the dispersion of 256 independently seeded chain means (1000 warmup sweeps, 32768 samples per chain at one sweep each, 8,388,608 samples), checked against temporal blocking: 2.867e-6 at blocks of 1024 and 2.84e-6 to 2.92e-6 for every block size >= 256 (pyro-blocking.dat), so RULES.md 6 is met. Var(H) = <|E_loc|^2> - <Re E_loc>^2 of the total S.S Hamiltonian, complex wavefunction, +/- 0.022 J^2 by block jackknife (one run; the authors note the variance error is more sensitive to high-second-moment chains than the energy error and is not yet confirmed by a second run). Stored as Pauli total, x 16. The row's energy is the same measurement (corrections on the row), so the agreement check is exact. Measurement cost: 256 MPI ranks x 674 s.
